However, it is contraindicated in certain conditions. For the options: 1) A 62-year-old man with renal artery stenosis: Enalapril is contraindicated due to the risk of worsening renal function. 2) A 32-year-old pregnant female: Enalapril is contraindicated in pregnancy due to potential harm to the fetus. 3) A 41-year-old woman with hyperkalemia: Enalapril can exacerbate hyperkalemia, making it inappropriate. 4) A 56-year-old diabetic woman: Enalapril is appropriate as it provides cardiovascular and renal protection in diabetic patients. Therefore, the best first-line agent for high blood pressure control in this scenario is the 56-year-old diabetic woman.
